No direct inspection corridor exists between Facility Alpha and Facility Beta.
Furthermore, due to scheduling conflicts, the inspection circuit must incorporate precisely one of the following two critical links: the corridor between Beta and Gamma, or the corridor between Gamma and Delta.

The objective is to determine the most time-efficient cyclical itinerary that inspects every facility exactly once before concluding at the point of origin.
